args.searchQuestion: Which original paper by Mao, Kaastra and Badnell, published in Astronomy & Astrophysics 599 A10 (2017), DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/201629708, defines the radiative-recombination electron energy-loss factor f=L/(k_B T alpha), its temperature fit formula, and the charge-state indexing convention?

references.title: The electron energy loss rate due to radiative recombination
references.read_scope: Relevant Eqs.1-7, Table2 indexing, temperature conventions and Section4.4; exact read ledger retained
references.own_summary: The paper defines the Maxwellian electron-loss factor L/(kT alpha), supplies a fit using electron temperature in eV, and treats transfer of that factor to other total RR data as an assumption. It does not certify the project hybrid or derivative error.
references.role: Thermal-closure context; RR/Mao enclosure excluded from selected DR unit

references.title: Partial and Total DR Rate Coefficients
references.read_scope: Total-fit formula, units and initial-target indexing
references.own_summary: The author documentation gives T^(-3/2) times a sum of c exp(-E/T), with E in the chosen temperature units and rates in cm^3/s. The new unit binds the frozen project rows, not a newly downloaded live table.
